name: SFH617A-3X007T
title: Single-channel phototransistor optocoupler, 5300 VRMS, 110 °C, DIP-4 and SMD-4
summary: SFH617A is an infrared LED and an NPN phototransistor sealed in one four-pin package, for passing signals between two circuits kept electrically apart. It is sorted into four current-transfer-ratio bins from 40 % to 320 % and comes as a 7.62 mm DIP-4, a 400 mil DIP-4 and two SMD-4 lead forms. The insulation is tested at 5300 VRMS for 1 s, rated 4470 VRMS for 1 min, and the part runs from -55 °C to +110 °C. SFH617A-3X007T is bin 3 (100 % to 200 %) in the option 7 SMD-4 form on tape and reel.

operation.text: A gallium arsenide infrared LED is optically coupled to a silicon planar NPN phototransistor in a four-pin plastic DIP. There is no base pin. The parts stack end to end on a 2.54 mm pitch. Rated for -55 °C to +110 °C, with a 70 V collector-emitter rating, low saturation voltage and low coupling capacitance. Listed uses: AC adapters, switch-mode supplies, PLCs, factory automation and game consoles.

SFH617A-#X0##T: the digit after the dash is the CTR bin (1 to 4); X0## is the package option (006 for the 400 mil DIP-4, 007 for SMD-4 option 7, 009 for SMD-4 option 9; 001, 016, 017 and 019 are the same packages with VDE approval); T means tape and reel. A plain SFH617A-# is the standard 7.62 mm DIP-4. SFH617A-3X017T and SFH617A-2X019T also come in tubes, ordered without the T. Lead spacing: DIP-4 7.62 mm, option 6 10.16 mm, option 7 over 8 mm, option 9 8 mm typical.

At IF = 10 mA and VCE = 5 V the four bins span 40-80 %, 63-125 %, 100-200 % and 160-320 %. At 1 mA the minimums drop to 13, 22, 34 and 56 %. Bins 3 and 4 carry the higher dark-current limit, 100 nA against 50 nA at VCE = 10 V. In the saturated switching data each bin is driven at its own LED current: 20 mA for bin 1, 10 mA for bins 2 and 3, 5 mA for bin 4.

Normalized to its value at IF = 10 mA, the ratio peaks at about 6 mA (about 1.1 at 25 °C) and falls on both sides, to roughly 0.3 to 0.55 at 50 mA. Below a few milliamps it falls steeply. Over temperature it is highest near 0 °C at 5 mA and drops to about 0.6 at 110 °C.

Times are measured on the collector-current pulse against the LED pulse. Delay time ends when IC reaches 10 %; rise time runs from 10 % to 90 %; storage time runs from the end of the LED pulse until IC has fallen to 90 %; fall time runs from 90 % to 10 %. Turn-on is delay plus rise, turn-off is storage plus fall. Non-saturated with RL = 75 Ω, ton is 3 µs and toff 2.3 µs; saturated, toff is 18 µs to 25 µs, and with VCE = 5 V and IF = 10 mA toff reaches about 160 µs at a 20 kΩ load while ton stays near 1.6 µs.

SFH617A is the model number under which every version is listed with the safety agencies. Approvals: UL, cUL, BSI, FIMKO and CQC for all versions; DIN EN 60747-5-5 (VDE 0884-5) for option 1 versions only. Option 6 gives creepage and clearance of 8 mm or more.

The top carries the UL mark, the base part number with its bin (for example SFH617A-3) and a line V YWW followed by a two-digit code, with a dot at pin 1. The VDE mark is on option 1 parts only. Neither the package option nor the T suffix is marked.
DIP-4 ships in tubes of 100, 40 tubes to a box. Options 7 and 9 ship on 13 inch reels in 16 mm carrier tape with a 12 mm pocket pitch.

Through-hole parts: double-wave soldering per CECC00802, preheat to 100 °C to 130 °C at about 2 K/s, then about 200 K/s up to the waves at 235 °C to 260 °C, with 5 s marked at the peak; cooling at about 2 K/s, then about 5 K/s, forced cooling. Surface-mount parts: lead-free reflow per J-STD-020 with ramp up at 3 °C/s max to 150 °C, 150 °C to 200 °C in 120 s max, above 217 °C for 100 s max, peak 260 °C max with the solid profile at 245 °C, above 255 °C for 30 s max, ramp down at 6 °C/s max.
